title: Post-dated cheques: the due date posts nothing and the journals of receipt and delivery carry the issue date; the reference system refuses a collection dated before the due date, accepts a deposit before it and a future-dated collection; there is no cheque module yet

post_dated_received.note: A received cheque of 50 later edited to 60 due in two months: its receipt journal 000186 is dated the issue date, identical to a cheque due today, and an edit changes it in place; endorsement is a label that adds no journal

date_rules.note: A collection dated before the due date is refused by the server with a message and writes nothing; a deposit before the due date is accepted; a collection on the due date is accepted and its journal 000188 is dated that future day; after the first deposit or collection the financial fields are locked

post_dated_paid.note: A post-dated payable cheque of 80 issued and delivered with its journal 000193 dated the issue date; collecting it before the due date is refused in the same way

cases.reason: There are no cheques here, so there is no due date to check a collection against (WP26). The rules the reference system showed are recorded for it: the receipt and the delivery are dated the issue date whatever the due date, a collection before the due date is refused with the message below, a deposit before it is accepted, and a collection on the due date posts a journal dated that day.

reference.refusal_message: تاريخ التحصيل يجب أن يكون أكبر من أو يساوي تاريخ الاستحقاق
